title: `react-router typegen` (and `dev`/`build`) crash with `generate is not a function` when run under the Bun runtime (`bun --bun` / `bunx --bun`)
author: mathhulk
body_preview: ### Reproduction  `@react-router/dev@8.0.0`'s typegen unwraps the default export of `@babel/generator` and `@babel/traverse` as `_mod.default`, which assumes Node.js's ESM↔CJS interop. Under the Bun runtime, a CJS module that sets `__esModule` is imported *unwrapped* (the default import **is** the function), so `_mod.default` is `undefined` and typegen throws.
